description: List, search, read, create, update, move, and delete notes; create folders; and review todos through the official Youdao Note MCP service.

auth.label: Youdao Note API Key
auth.placeholder: Paste your Youdao Note API Key
auth.description: API Key sent to the official Youdao Note MCP service as x-api-key. Create a key at https://mopen.163.com after binding a phone number to your Youdao Note account.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call an advanced Youdao Note MCP tool after using list_tools to inspect its exact name and arguments. Prefer direct actions for common note operations.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the tool's live inputSchema.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current Youdao Note MCP tool.

result.description: Structured MCP content, parsed JSON/text, or the original MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by Youdao Note.

actions.name: create_folder
actions.description: Create a folder inside a selected Youdao Note directory.

parentId.description: The destination folder ID. Use "0" for the root directory or a folder ID returned by list_notes.

inputSchema.description: The parent directory and new folder name.

result.description: Structured data or text returned by Youdao Note.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by the official Youdao Note MCP tool.

actions.name: create_note
actions.description: Create a Youdao note in the default location or a selected folder.

title.description: The note title, up to 80 characters. Do not include \, /, :, *, ?, ", <, >, or |.

content.description: The note content. Omit it to create an empty note.

parentId.description: The destination folder ID. Use "0" for the root directory or a folder ID returned by list_notes.

inputSchema.description: The new note's title, content, and optional destination folder.

result.description: Structured data or text returned by Youdao Note.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by the official Youdao Note MCP tool.

actions.name: delete_note
actions.description: Delete one Youdao note by file ID. Folders cannot be deleted with this action.

fileId.description: The note file ID from list_notes or search_notes. The selected entry must have dir=false.

result.description: Structured data or text returned by Youdao Note.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by the official Youdao Note MCP tool.

actions.name: get_note_content
actions.description: Read the text content of one Youdao note by its file ID.

fileId.description: The note file ID from list_notes or search_notes. The selected entry must have dir=false.

result.description: Structured data or text returned by Youdao Note.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by the official Youdao Note MCP tool.

actions.name: get_recent_favorites
actions.description: List recently favorited Youdao notes, including their text content. This does not list recently updated notes.

limit.description: The maximum number of notes to return.

inputSchema.description: The number of recently favorited notes to return.

result.description: Structured data or text returned by Youdao Note.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by the official Youdao Note MCP tool.

actions.name: list_notes
actions.description: List notes and folders directly inside a Youdao Note directory, with cursor pagination.

parentId.description: The destination folder ID. Use "0" for the root directory or a folder ID returned by list_notes.

lastId.description: The last entry ID from the previous page. Omit it when requesting the first page.

inputSchema.description: The directory and optional pagination cursor.

result.description: Structured data or text returned by Youdao Note.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by the official Youdao Note MCP tool.

actions.name: list_todos
actions.description: List all Youdao Note todos or only todos in one group.

groupId.description: The todo group ID. Omit it to list todos from all groups.

result.description: Structured data or text returned by Youdao Note.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by the official Youdao Note MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover advanced Youdao Note MCP tools that do not already have a direct OpenConnector action.

name.description: The exact MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The tool description supplied by Youdao Note.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may modify or delete data.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls are expected to be idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with external entities.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by Youdao Note.

inputSchema.description: The live JSON Schema for this tool's arguments.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by the connected Youdao Note account.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed to the connected account.

outputSchema.description: The current Youdao Note MCP tool catalog.

actions.name: move_note
actions.description: Move a Youdao note into another directory. Only entries with dir=false can be moved.

fileId.description: The note file ID from list_notes or search_notes. The selected entry must have dir=false.

targetParentId.description: The destination folder ID. Use "0" for the root directory or a folder ID returned by list_notes.

result.description: Structured data or text returned by Youdao Note.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by the official Youdao Note MCP tool.

actions.name: rename_note
actions.description: Rename a Youdao note. Folders cannot be renamed with this action.

fileId.description: The note file ID from list_notes or search_notes. The selected entry must have dir=false.

newTitle.description: The new note title. Do not include path separators.

inputSchema.description: The note and its new title.

result.description: Structured data or text returned by Youdao Note.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by the official Youdao Note MCP tool.

actions.name: search_notes
actions.description: Search Youdao Note titles and content. Results are returned in pages of 15 entries.

keyword.description: The text to search for in note titles and content.

startIndex.description: The result offset. Use 0 for the first page, 15 for the second, and so on.

inputSchema.description: The note search query and optional zero-based page offset.

result.description: Structured data or text returned by Youdao Note.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by the official Youdao Note MCP tool.

actions.name: update_markdown_note
actions.description: Replace the complete content of an existing Markdown note and optionally rename it.

fileId.description: The note file ID from list_notes or search_notes. The selected entry must have dir=false.

content.description: The complete Markdown content that will replace the existing note content.

title.description: An optional replacement title ending in .md.

inputSchema.description: The Markdown note and its complete replacement content.

result.description: Structured data or text returned by Youdao Note.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by the official Youdao Note MCP tool.
